name: Claw
notes: Scope: Claw ranks 1-4 only (ranks 5-8 researched by another agent).

Wowhead Classic spell pages (16827/16828/16829/16830) gave spell IDs and required levels (1/8/16/24, from the 'see-also-ability' listview and the tooltip text 'Requires level N'). They have NO 'Taught by NPC'/'Learned from' listview for these pet spells, and show no training-point cost, so wowhead-classic tp = null. The only TP text on those pages is a user comment that copies Petopia; it is not counted as a Wowhead observation.

Wowhead beast observations come from Wowhead's tooltip JSON (nether.wowhead.com/<classic|forever>/tooltip/npc/<id>; see 'dataVia'), because full www.wowhead.com pages started returning HTTP 403 (CloudFront 'Request blocked') after the first few fetches. The tooltips give name, level range, classification (Normal/Elite/Rare), family and zone ID (zone IDs turned into names with nether.wowhead.com tooltip/zone). They do NOT say which Claw rank a beast teaches, so wowhead observations have rank = null. They confirm the NPC exists, its levels and its flags only.

Wowhead has a Forever section (www.wowhead.com/forever/...). Its full pages were 403-blocked too. Its tooltip JSON worked and resolves the Forever-only NPC IDs (248299, 250926-250937, 251115, 254588, 276111, 276189), which return 'Entity not found' on the Classic tooltip endpoint.

petopia-classic and petopia-forever are two sections of the SAME site (wow-petopia.com, same editors). Treat them as one source for independence counting. They are kept separate because their data differs (Forever lists extra beasts). Petopia's beast links point to classic.wowhead.com/npc=<id> (classic section) and www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=<id> (forever section). Petopia does not show spell IDs (null) or elite/rare flags (omitted). Petopia writes 'Blackfathom Deeps (Dungeon)'; it is kept verbatim.

warcrafttavern = Warcraft Tavern 'Petpedia' per-beast pages (warcrafttavern.com/wow-classic/hunter-pets/pets/<slug>/). Each shows 'Skills When Tamed: Claw N', the pet level range, the zone, and 'Class Rare/Elite' when it applies. This is Classic data only; Warcraft Tavern has no Forever pet database. A missing Class field was not taken to mean normal (elite/rare left out). The 'black-bear' slug redirected to Black Bear Patriarch, so it was dropped, and no Warcraft Tavern page exists for Black Bear (1129). Pages for Forever-only NPCs returned 404.

warcraft.wiki.gg 'Claw (pet ability)' (fetched with WebFetch; direct curl is blocked by wiki.gg) has no per-rank table and no beast lists for Classic. It lists only 8 ranks, families (Bear, Carrion Bird, Cat, Crab, Owl, Raptor, Scorpid) and Wowhead links for 16827 (rank 1) and 3009 (rank 8). No observation was recorded from it. wowpedia.fandom.com is behind a Cloudflare challenge (403).
Rank data agreement: Wowhead and Petopia (both sections) agree on pet levels 1/8/16/24. Petopia (both sections) gives TP 1/4/7/10. No second independent source for TP was found.

FOREVER-SPECIFIC (only in petopia-forever; the Wowhead Forever tooltips confirm the NPCs exist): Claw 1 adds Scrawny Ursera 250926 (Bear, 3-4), Ursera Scavenger 250937 (Bear, 4), Urs'anah 251115 (Bear, 5, subtitle 'The Den Mother'), Highlands Ursera 250928 (Bear, 7-8), all in Zephras Isle (a new Forever zone, Wowhead zone 16593, level 1-12). It also adds Swoop 2970 (Carrion Bird, 7-9, Mulgore) and Black Bear 1129 (Bear, Dun Morogh). Claw 2 adds Windsong Crawler 254588 (Crab, 8-9, Zephras Isle), Shadowgale Ursera 250927 (Bear, 10-11, Zephras Isle), Matriarch Bristlefur 276189 (Bear, 10, Elwynn Forest, Rare per Wowhead), Ghostfang 276111 (Cat, 10, Dun Morogh, Rare per Wowhead) and Elmpaw 248299 (Bear, 12, Elwynn Forest, Elite per Wowhead).

Swoop (2970) and Black Bear (1129) are Classic NPC IDs, but Classic sources do not list them as Claw teachers: petopia-classic leaves them out, and Warcraft Tavern's Swoop page says 'Skills When Tamed: None'. So in Forever they appear to have gained Claw 1. Single source (petopia-forever) only.

Forever family change: petopia-forever and the Wowhead Forever tooltip list Strigid Owl / Strigid Hunter as family 'Bird of Prey' (Classic: 'Owl'). Petopia's Forever differences page says Owls are part of Birds of Prey in Forever.

Level differences seen: Black Bear 1129 is '7' in petopia-forever but 6-7 on Wowhead (classic and forever). Den Mother 6788 is 18-19 in petopia-classic, Warcraft Tavern and Wowhead, but 19 in petopia-forever. Snapping Crustacean 4822 is 23-24 in petopia-classic and Warcraft Tavern, 22-23 in petopia-forever, and 23-25 on Wowhead. Skittering Crustacean 4821 is 22-23 on Petopia and Warcraft Tavern but 22-25 on Wowhead. Shore Crawler 1216 is spelled 'Shorecrawler' in petopia-forever but 'Shore Crawler' on Wowhead Forever.

Elite/rare per Wowhead tooltips: Bjarn 1130 Rare, Death Flayer 5823 Rare, Ol' Sooty 1225 Elite, Skittering/Snapping/Barbed Crustacean 4821/4822/4823 Elite (Blackfathom Deeps dungeon), Elmpaw 248299 Elite, Ghostfang 276111 Rare, Matriarch Bristlefur 276189 Rare. Mangeclaw 1961 shows as Normal on Wowhead.
Extra fields 'family', 'classification', 'skillsWhenTamed', 'linkedUrl' and 'dataVia' are added for context. The generator may ignore them.
